Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai Anime Overview:

Classmates often perceive high school student Sato as an unapproachable figure due to her consistently distant and austere demeanor toward everyone around her. However, her public facade conceals a vastly different personality that only her peer Oshio gets to witness firsthand. Behind closed doors, Sato reveals a shy, easily embarrassed side that she reserves exclusively for him. Meanwhile, Oshio navigates his own secret life managing digital communications for his family-run establishment after school hours, a responsibility that brings out a more thoughtful and focused aspect of his character. As the two teenagers spend time together away from prying eyes, they begin sharing private moments that highlight their contrasting public and personal identities. This romantic comedy series chronicles the gradual development of their relationship as they awkwardly yet sincerely learn to express their true feelings to one another for the first time.

Japanese Title: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い

Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston Anime Overview:

An invincible legendary hero passes away peacefully of old age, deeply dissatisfied that she spent her entire life without ever meeting an opponent strong enough to defeat her in combat. Reincarnated into a second chance at life, she wakes up in the fragile physical form of a sickly young noble girl named Nia Liston. Far from discouraged by her new weak constitution and the challenges of her unfamiliar upbringing, the former warrior embraces the opportunity with intense enthusiasm. Determined to overcome her current physical limitations through rigorous training and discipline, she sets out on a journey to cultivate her strength once more, eager to pursue the thrilling martial challenges she missed out on during her first lifetime.

record.text: Technical products are where it breaks. The model doesn't know what your equipment looks like, so it invents a believable version. Get CAD drawings, renders or real photos first and build the technical shots from those. Without them you're guessing.
